data.current_description: Monthly spend per key. Up to 3 months for the organization or 12 for one key. Months with no activity are left out; `totals` covers every month.
data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve organization or key-level spend history
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves monthly spend report for your organization or a specific API key. Supports querying up to 3 months of organization-wide spend or 12 months for a single key.
